items.label: USAO-MA civil: SMI Demolition, Inc.
items.detail: False Claims Act settlement over PPP and EIDL loans obtained while an owner had a felony fraud conviction; date is the announcement date. The $2.01 million is paid jointly with owner Charles Smith, Jr. and not split; the defendants admitted the facts while the US contends the claims were false, so admission is left blank. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ma-2025-smi-demolition; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.reason: Shared total, split not stated: Filed settlement agreement: SMI Demolition and its owner Charles Smith, Jr. collectively pay $2,011,900 plus 5% interest from 10 June 2025, jointly and severally liable, no split. The table holds the release's rounded 2,010,000; five instalments from 29 Aug 2025 to 29 Aug 2029; $11,910 more goes to the relator's counsel. Source (read 2026-10-11): "The Defendants collectively shall pay to the United States Two Million Eleven Thousand Nine Hundred Dollars ($2,011,900) plus interest". The primary document gives one total for payers that include anyone outside the company, so the total is counted for no company; the row stays in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ma-2025-smi-demolition; data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
